results.title: Ghost Noon
results.overview: Vom Geist der Schwere! Become a ghost at noon, open a spectral drift with no terminus—escape, defection, exile, nomadism—from this point on one cannot be pinned down by any exact and unshifting identification in time or in coordinates. Under the shadow of the state machine’s perpetual operation, hauntology emerges as a methodology of survival against a pervasive spiritual decline—even as it all is ultimately destined to fail.

results.title: Slip Stream
results.overview: “I have lived my life in the slipstream of experience.” – Elizabeth Jane Howard

results.title: The Murmuring Deep
results.overview: The Murmuring Deep is a sensorial non-fiction film that delves into a fractured view of the world as a play of mirrors, existing only as reflections of and in each other. Through a biological lens, the film seeks to glimpse the ecstatic chaos that underlies all reality.

results.title: Toss a Rose Over
results.overview: The green ones share stories of change in this travelogue from the vantage point of plants. In a canyon where all things move, these ancient beings urge humanity to reconsider acts of interspecies and intraspecies relation during a current period of intense anthropogenic climate change.

results.title: Neighbors from the Sky
results.overview: Over the span of three years, the film captures the depletion of the wild bird population surrounding one person’s home during a spike in the avian flu.

results.title: time is a bird
results.overview: Light is motion, motion is time, time is a bird. Repetitive, seasonally cyclical process of recording Icelandic webcam screenshots, this time focusing on the light monsters that through camera lenses and glass fibres travel great underwater intercontinental distances. Visually encoded in this film is the message, "There is no valid reference frame in which light is at rest."

results.title: solanaceae
results.overview: solanaceae is structured like an invocation. A voice addresses us without revealing its origin. It speaks of rituals, healing and intoxication, of a knowledge that has been revered and persecuted for centuries. Only gradually does the perspective shift: the voice does not belong to a human being. It is not a plant being invoked—the plant itself speaks from the ground. In a time of collective exhaustion, the work asks about other forms of knowledge, memory and transformation. The starting point is research into henbane, a plant that has been associated with magical practices and transformation for centuries.

results.title: Liquid Courage
results.overview: An aspiring artist is stuck as a bartender when she is encouraged by a loud, talking bottle of alcohol to throw everything away and chase her dreams.

results.title: Dancer of the Republic
results.overview: As Linda prepares to dance in a cabaret in Beirut, the end of the Lebanese Civil War is proclaimed. The announcement of the Syrian regime’s troops entering Lebanon makes Linda question whether the war has truly come to an end.

results.title: Smarty
results.overview: Exiled director Nikita Lavretski (played by Belarusian director Sergey Kolosovski) strives to reunite with his wife across European borders. Reminiscing about the home he had to leave, he wonders whether he is stuck reliving his past forever.

results.title: Half Moon
results.overview: Riley and Lucy used to be close friends but have since grown apart over the years. While Lucy's long-term boyfriend is away at a bachelor party, she invites Riley to spend the weekend at her family's house upstate (now converted into an Airbnb), a trip they used to take together. Both live in New York, but haven't spent extended time together in years. Unspoken tensions surface as it becomes apparent how much distance there is between the two of them. Over the course of the weekend, they find small but unexpected ways to reconnect.

results.title: Andromeda Interlaced
results.overview: A shut-in girl loses her mind when an alien signal communicates with her through her CRT TV.

results.title: Death Came Knocking
results.overview: In the summer of 1978, two cousins are trapped inside their childhood home by a group of strangers. As the night continues, survival slowly turns to murder.

results.title: Mr. & Mrs. Christmas
results.overview: Taylor Lewis, a single father and expert in holiday displays, moves to the picturesque town of Pineway with his two children just weeks before Christmas. While the family adjusts to a new home and school, Taylor also faces the realization that his teenage daughter may be growing out of some of their treasured Christmas traditions.  When Taylor becomes involved in reviving Pineway's Christmas Market, he's paired with Sophie Shaw, a practical accountant eager to prove herself as a potential leader. Their different approaches soon complement each other, bringing new life and festive spirit to the town.  As Taylor tries to hold onto the Christmas traditions his family once shared, he discovers that meaningful moments can't simply be recreated. Growing closer to Sophie along the way, he begins to see that embracing change can lead to new traditions, new memories, and perhaps an unexpected new beginning.

results.title: Prosthetika
results.overview: Sara, a tormented special effects makeup artist, plumbs the depths of her subconscious to confront her complex relationship with her appearance, reconnect with her identity and – if she can – find her way to self-love.

results.title: Follow Me
results.overview: When Gidon Lev was just 6 years old, he arrived at the Nazi concentration camp of Theresienstadt. When he was 85 years old, he took social media by storm.

results.title: Don‘t Disturb
results.overview: After his father's death, an estranged son keeps the death certificate to extort his family for a share of the inherited land. But when he trespasses onto the property, he unknowingly insults the 'Datuk Gong' beneath a sacred tree, unleashing a terrifying curse upon himself.

results.title: Do It Live
results.overview: A newscaster has a mental breakdown behind the scenes.

results.title: Nurture
results.overview: When a global pandemic shuts Hong Kong’s borders, hundreds of thousands of foreign domestic workers are stranded far from home. Among them is Sonia, a strong-willed Indonesian domestic worker whose world is shattered when she learns that her mother has died. Unable to return home, she takes it upon herself to organize the funeral from afar, piecing together a final farewell through a livestream thousands of miles away. But she’s forced to choose between her mother’s final farewell and the woman who depends on her for care.

results.title: Le'a
results.overview: On Oʻahu, a college student’s suppressed desire for her best friend forces them both on a sugar daddy date with a wealthy ex-military man turned artist, where desire and power unravel each other.
